world_org_meetings.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
world_org_meetings.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

world_org_meetings.title: What to know as world leaders converge at the United Nations this week
world_org_meetings.description: United Nations head António Guterres returns to New York for his final U.N. General Assembly as diplomacy falters over wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, and the global body faces deep divisions.

world_org_meetings.title: US networks halt Trump coverage after three media outlets banned
world_org_meetings.description: US television networks on Monday effectively boycotted coverage of President Donald Trump in protest at his decision to ban three leading outlets - CNN, MS NOW and Politico - from the White House. As a result, Trump's opening of his cherished new White House helipad and his trip to the United Nations General Assembly proceeded without live television coverage.

world_org_meetings.title: World leaders gather at UN amid wars, AI fears and global divisions
world_org_meetings.description: World leaders are gathering at the United Nations this week against a backdrop of wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, rising fears over artificial intelligence and mounting economic and climate pressures. The annual General Assembly will test whether the 193-member body can still bring countries together to tackle crises that increasingly transcend borders.

world_org_meetings.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill three as Zelenskyy in US for UN summit
world_org_meetings.description: Overnight missile and drone attacks hit several Ukrainian regions as world leaders gather in New York, US.

diplomatic_visits.title: As Trump-Xi summit nears, Europe is caught in middle of US-China rivalry
diplomatic_visits.description: China's Xi Jinping is traveling to Washington this week. Regardless of what comes from his talks with US President Trump, the EU will likely remain stuck between erratic US trade policy and Beijing's export machine.

diplomatic_visits.title: Defining global leadership in AI at Trump-Xi summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Former U.S. deputy national security advisor Anne Neuberger is watching for signs of competition and cooperation on artificial intelligence at President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping's summit this week.

diplomatic_visits.title: Carney touts Arctic alliance with Norway during PM's visit to Ottawa, amid Russia threat
diplomatic_visits.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney is courting deeper defence ties with Norway, as well as investment from its massive, petroleum-based sovereign wealth fund.

diplomatic_visits.title: Deported to Africa: An international investigation into Trump’s migrant policy
diplomatic_visits.description: As part of a consortium of 26 media outlets coordinated by Forbidden Stories, FRANCE 24 and RFI spent seven months investigating the secret deals struck between the administration of US President Donald Trump and several African countries. These “third countries” have agreed to host undocumented migrants detained by ICE and deported from the United States.

diplomatic_visits.title: Taiwan holds first joint military drills using attack drones ahead of Trump-Xi summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Taiwan’s president has overseen military drills featuring missiles and drones on Friday, ahead of a planned summit next week between the U.S. and Chinese leaders in which the fate of the self-ruled island will be discussed

elections.title: 'No surprises' as results emerge in Russian parliamentary election
elections.description: Preliminary results suggest that Kremlin-backed United Russia is on course to retain its constitutional majority.

elections.title: Ethiopia's main armed groups form anti-government alliance
elections.description: In tonight's edition: A coalition of opposition groups band together in the hope of ousting Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed. Also, we speak to the deputy chief of the UN's peacekeeping mission in DR Congo. And with just a few days to go before legislative elections, young Moroccans are torn between hope and scepticism ahead of the crucial vote.

elections.title: Paramount, US states settle antitrust lawsuit over Warner Bros. acquisition
elections.description: Paramount Skydance has settled a lawsuit with a dozen US states that sought to block its acquisition of Warner Brothers, as well as with the Writers Guild of America. California's attorney general said that while the settlement addressed concerns over competition and protection, it did not mean a vote of support for the deal.

elections.title: Russians abroad voted eight to one against Putin's party, defying official results
elections.description: Two independent exit polls covering 27 countries put New People first with around 45% and United Russia as low as 2.8%, the reverse of official results inside Russia, where Putin's party took nearly 58%. Exit poll organisers said the gap "destroys the image of supposed support for the authorities."

elections.title: Brazil election: Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro tied in latest polls
elections.description: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva is running in October's election for a fourth non-consecutive term as Brazil's president.
